question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Visit the IT portal at it.concordia.ca and click Forgot Password to reset via email.

question: Where is the registrar office?
answer: The registrar office is located in the Hall Building room H-125.

question: How do I pay tuition?
answer: Tuition can be paid online through the My CU Account finance portal.

question: How do I contact technical support?
answer: Email iits@concordia.ca or call the helpdesk at 514-848-2424 ext. 7613.

question: What are the library hours?
answer: The Webster Library is open Monday to Friday 8 AM to 10 PM and weekends 10 AM to 6 PM.

question: How do I register for courses?
answer: Log into the Student Hub portal and navigate to the Course Registration section.

question: How can I apply for scholarships?
answer: Visit the Scholarships and Bursaries section on the Concordia financial aid website.

question: Where can I find my class schedule?
answer: Log into the Student Hub and click on My Schedule under the Academics tab.

question: How can I get to class?
answer: Check your class schedule and room locations in the Student Hub under My Schedule. For campus directions use the Concordia maps at concordia.ca/maps.

question: How do I get a student ID card?
answer: Visit the Customer Relations Centre in the Hall Building with a valid photo ID.

question: What is the deadline to drop a course?
answer: The deadline to drop a course without academic penalty is typically 6 weeks after the start of term.

question: How do I access my grades?
answer: Grades are posted on the Student Hub under the Academics section after the final exam period.

question: Where is student health services?
answer: Student health and wellness is located in the Hall Building room H-110.

question: How do I apply for a leave of absence?
answer: Submit a leave of absence request through the registrar's office or via the Student Hub portal.

question: How do I get a transcript?
answer: Official transcripts can be ordered online through the Student Hub under Enrolment and Student Records.

question: Where can I print on campus?
answer: Printing services are available in all library locations and most computer labs across campus.

question: Where is the Birks Student Service Centre?
answer: The Birks Student Service Centre is at LB-185 in the J.W. McConnell Building at the SGW campus. Call 514-848-2424 ext. 2668 or email students@concordia.ca.

question: How do I access mental health counselling?
answer: Contact Counselling and Psychological Services at cps.info@concordia.ca or 514-848-2424 ext. 3545. Undergraduate and graduate students can also use Empower Me at 1-855-853-0565.

question: Where is the International Students Office?
answer: The ISO is in room GM-330 of the Guy-De Maisonneuve Building. Call 514-848-2424 ext. 3515 or email iso@concordia.ca Monday to Friday 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.

question: How do I register for academic accommodations?
answer: Email your documentation to acsd.intake@concordia.ca with your full name and Concordia ID. The Access Centre for Students with Disabilities will contact you for an intake appointment.

question: How do I get support after sexual violence?
answer: Contact the Sexual Assault Resource Centre at sarc@concordia.ca or 514-848-2424 ext. 3353. For immediate danger on campus call Campus Security at 514-848-3717 option 1.

question: Where is Le Gym and what are the hours?
answer: Le Gym is at EV-S2-206 on the SGW campus. Hours are Monday to Friday 6:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. and weekends 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Call 514-848-2424 ext. 3860.

question: How do I accept a scholarship or bursary?
answer: Log into the Student Hub and open My CU Account then Student Centre. Under Finances select Accept/Decline Awards and submit your choices for the aid year.

question: How do I check holds on my student account?
answer: Log into the Student Hub and open My CU Account then Student Centre. View Holds on your account to see what is blocking registration or other services.

question: Where is the Loyola campus library?
answer: The Vanier Library is on the Loyola campus at 7141 Sherbrooke Street West. It is Concordia's main library on the Loyola side alongside Webster Library downtown.

question: How do I book a group study room?
answer: Book a group study room through the Concordia Library website at library.concordia.ca using your Concordia account.

question: How do I contact IT for help?
answer: Email help@concordia.ca or submit a support request through the IT service catalogue at concordia.ca/it. Visit an on-campus IT Service Centre for in-person help.

question: What is my Concordia student email?
answer: Your Concordia email is your netname followed by @concordia.ca. Set up and manage your netname and accounts through the Student Hub and concordia.ca/it.

question: Where can I get a medical note for class?
answer: Health Services can provide medical notes when appropriate. Book at 514-848-2424 ext. 3565 (SGW GM-200) or ext. 3575 (Loyola AD-131).

question: How do I request a refund from my student account?
answer: If awards or payments leave a credit balance log into Student Centre under Finances and request a refund through your account inquiry options.

question: Where is the Financial Aid and Awards Office?
answer: Visit concordia.ca/students/financial for scholarships bursaries and awards. Accept awards through Student Centre under Finances in My CU Account.

question: How do I get help with a co-op or internship letter?
answer: Contact the Office of Student Life and Engagement at studentlife@concordia.ca or 514-848-2424 ext. 3517 in the Hall Building room H-659 for convention de stage support.

question: What should I do in a mental health crisis?
answer: For urgent mental health support call Empower Me at 1-855-853-0565 or Info-Social at 8-1-1. On campus contact Campus Security at 514-848-3717 option 1 if you are in immediate danger.
